# Test fixtures

`fixtures/noted-exercise.pdf` is an original synthetic score-like PDF created
for this repository and dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. Its
generator sources are in `fixtures/generate/`.

The fixture contains no uploaded user score and is safe for unit and browser
tests. Runtime uploads belong only under the gitignored `.local/` directory.

`noted-valid-ccitt.pdf` is a corrected single-strip encoding of the original CC0
fixture artwork, generated by `tools/score-intake-proof/generate-ccitt.py`. The
older `noted-ccitt-exercise.pdf` remains a deliberately recognized malformed
baseline: its generator concatenates independent TIFF strips. The new parser
rejects that incomplete stream; acceptance tests use the valid fixture.

`noted-photo-exif-6.jpg` and `noted-photo-exif-8.jpg` are JPEG versions of the same
original CC0 artwork with EXIF orientations 6 and 8. They verify that image
preview and worker export use the displayed orientation, rather than the raw
JPEG dimensions. No uploaded user music or external edition is included.
